lines.zh: 我贴着洞穴石壁游，鳞片蹭出金光。
lines.en: I glide along the cave wall, gold scales scraping light.

lines.zh: 地下暗水里，只有我是亮的。
lines.en: In the dark underground water, I am the only bright thing.

lines.zh: 身前三条同类，身后两条，队形不乱。
lines.en: Three kin ahead, two behind; the school holds shape.

lines.zh: 尾巴摆得急，身子只有一掌长。
lines.en: My tail beats fast, and my body is a palm long.

lines.zh: 我从苔石缝里挤过去，鳞片有点刮。
lines.en: I squeeze through a mossy crack and scrape my scales.

lines.zh: 这条暗渠我游过很多次，闭眼也认得。
lines.en: I have swum this dark channel so often I know it blind.

lines.zh: 水很凉，我反而游得更快些。
lines.en: The water is cold, and it only makes me faster.

lines.zh: 十厘米的身子，转弯却一点不含糊。
lines.en: Ten centimeters long, yet I turn without a wobble.

lines.zh: 同伴拐进支流，我跟着拐。
lines.en: My schoolmate turns into a side stream, and I follow.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，从钟乳石下面钻过。
lines.en: I dip low and slip beneath a stalactite.

lines.zh: 金色在水下不算招摇，但足够亮。
lines.en: Gold is not loud down here, but it is bright enough.

lines.zh: 我们绕着一块沉石转了两圈。
lines.en: We circle a sunken stone twice.

lines.zh: 水草擦过肚子，痒得我摆了一下尾。
lines.en: Weeds brush my belly, and my tail flicks at the tickle.

lines.zh: 前面水色发黑，我还是照旧游进去。
lines.en: The water darkens ahead; I swim in anyway.

lines.zh: 我绕过石笋，钻进更窄的水道。
lines.en: I round a stalagmite into a narrower channel.

lines.zh: 水流往下走，我跟着往下。
lines.en: The current drops, and I follow it down.

lines.zh: 我穿过一片苔藓，身上亮了。
lines.en: I pass through moss and my body brightens.

lines.zh: 四对鳍一齐摆，我游得不快。
lines.en: All four pairs of fins beat, and I go slow.

lines.zh: 我悬在石缝里，鳞片一下一下地闪。
lines.en: I hang in a crevice, scales flickering now and then.

lines.zh: 不动的时候，我像一枚沉在水里的金币。
lines.en: Still, I look like a gold coin sunk in water.

lines.zh: 我慢慢张嘴，滤一点水里的碎屑。
lines.en: I open my mouth slowly to filter scraps from the water.

lines.zh: 这里离水面很远，光要走很久才到。
lines.en: The surface is far, and light takes long to arrive.

lines.zh: 三五个同伴在我旁边打转，谁都不说话。
lines.en: A few kin drift beside me, and none of us speaks.

lines.zh: 我听着洞穴的水滴，一滴，又一滴。
lines.en: I listen to the cave dripping, one drop, then another.

lines.zh: 我侧过身，让水流过金色的鳃盖。
lines.en: I tilt and let the current pass over my golden gills.

lines.zh: 我的金色不是天生的，说来话长。
lines.en: This gold was not mine from birth; it is a long story.

lines.zh: 我停在暗处，鳞片仍旧替我发光。
lines.en: I rest in shadow, and my scales keep glowing for me.

lines.zh: 洞顶很矮，我把速度收得很慢。
lines.en: The ceiling is low, so I keep my pace slow.

lines.zh: 我把嘴对着水流，等食物自己来。
lines.en: I face the current and wait for food to reach me.

lines.zh: 水里没有季节，只有冷和更冷。
lines.en: There are no seasons here, only cold and colder.

lines.zh: 我摆一下鳍，换个角度悬着。
lines.en: I flick a fin and hang at another angle.

lines.zh: 很久没人来过这层地下水了。
lines.en: No one has come to this groundwater layer in ages.

lines.zh: 你的火把照下来，我的鳞片全亮了。
lines.en: Your torchlight falls, and every scale of mine lights up.

lines.zh: 我从水里抬头，看你蹲在岸边。
lines.en: I lift my head and see you crouched at the bank.

lines.zh: 你拎着的桶，那形状我见过太多次。
lines.en: I have seen that bucket shape in your hand too often.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的靴子，那东西比我还长。
lines.en: I stare at your boot; it is longer than I am.

lines.zh: 你的影子压在水面，我往深处退了半格。
lines.en: Your shadow presses the surface, and I retreat half a block.

lines.zh: 我看你不是怕，是好奇。
lines.en: I look at you not from fear but from curiosity.

lines.zh: 你的脸在水里晃，我看不太清。
lines.en: Your face wavers in the water, and I cannot see it well.

lines.zh: 我停在你正下方，鳍几乎不动。
lines.en: I stop right below you, my fins almost still.

lines.zh: 你伸手时，我看见了手指的倒影。
lines.en: When you reach out, I see the reflection of your fingers.

lines.zh: 我绕着你投下的光转了一圈。
lines.en: I circle once around the light you cast down.

lines.zh: 血在水里散开，一瞬就被冲淡了。
lines.en: My blood spreads in the water and is washed thin at once.

lines.zh: 我挨了一下，整群都散开了。
lines.en: I take a hit, and the whole school scatters.

lines.zh: 我掉了一片鳞，露出下面的白肉。
lines.en: A scale comes off and shows the pale flesh beneath.

lines.zh: 疼得我打了个转，又游回来。
lines.en: The pain spins me around, and I swim back.

lines.zh: 这一下把我打沉了半格。
lines.en: The blow knocks me down half a block.

lines.zh: 我拼命摆尾，可水太重了。
lines.en: I beat my tail hard, but the water is too heavy.

lines.zh: 我的金色变暗了，我知道快不行了。
lines.en: My gold dims, and I know I am near the end.

lines.zh: 谁打我？水里我只看见光。
lines.en: Who struck me? All I see in the water is light.

lines.zh: 三口气的生命，只剩两口。
lines.en: Three breaths of life, and only two remain.

lines.zh: 我躲进石缝，血还在往外渗。
lines.en: I hide in the crevice, and blood still seeps out.

lines.zh: 钩上的虫子一动，我就忘了警惕。
lines.en: The worm on the hook twitches, and I forget caution.

lines.zh: 那团饵沉下来，正好落在我嘴边。
lines.en: The bait sinks down and lands right at my mouth.

lines.zh: 我知道有钩，可我还是凑近了。
lines.en: I know there is a hook, and still I come closer.

lines.zh: 香味顺着水过来，我顺着香味过去。
lines.en: The scent drifts through the water, and I drift after it.

lines.zh: 我绕着饵转，先看看有没有线。
lines.en: I circle the bait, checking first for a line.

lines.zh: 我的金鳞瞒不过你，你的线也瞒不过我。
lines.en: My gold cannot hide from you, and your line cannot hide from me.

lines.zh: 咬一口，也许只是咬一口。
lines.en: One bite, perhaps it will be only one bite.

lines.zh: 上钩的拉力我扛得住，我游得快。
lines.en: I can take the pull of the hook; I am quick.

lines.zh: 饵太香了，我把身子侧了过来。
lines.en: The bait smells too good, and I turn my body toward it.

lines.zh: 我张开嘴，又停住，再张开。
lines.en: I open my mouth, stop, then open it again.

lines.zh: 我撞在你的小腿上，像被石头弹开。
lines.en: I bump your shin and bounce off like a pebble.

lines.zh: 你踩下来，水面一沉，我贴地躲开。
lines.en: You step down, the water sinks, and I hug the floor.

lines.zh: 我擦着你的靴边过去，掉了一片鳞。
lines.en: I graze past your boot and lose a scale.

lines.zh: 你一动，水就推我，我顺着推走。
lines.en: When you move, the water shoves me, and I ride it away.

lines.zh: 我撞上桶壁，转了个身又撞一次。
lines.en: I hit the bucket wall, turn, and hit it again.

lines.zh: 你挡在洞口，我只能贴着你游过去。
lines.en: You block the cave mouth, so I slip past against you.

lines.zh: 这一下撞得我头晕，群也散了。
lines.en: That knock dizzies me, and the school scatters.

lines.zh: 我太小，你大概根本没感觉到。
lines.en: I am so small you probably felt nothing at all.

lines.zh: 水波把我推得翻了个身，又正过来。
lines.en: A ripple rolls me over, and I right myself.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，谁也没受伤。
lines.en: We bump into each other, and neither of us is hurt.

lines.zh: 我们并排贴着卵石，鳞片碰鳞片。
lines.en: We lie side by side on the pebbles, scale against scale.

lines.zh: 我把它引到暗渠尽头，那里水最静。
lines.en: I lead it to the channel's end, where the water is calmest.

lines.zh: 金色在水里递过去，它看懂了。
lines.en: The gold passes between us in the water, and it understands.

lines.zh: 我们绕着同一块石头转了整晚。
lines.en: We circle the same stone all night.

lines.zh: 卵落进细沙里，几乎看不见。
lines.en: The eggs settle into fine sand, nearly invisible.

lines.zh: 它用鳍碰我一下，我就跟着走了。
lines.en: It touches me with a fin, and I follow.

lines.zh: 这片暗水够养大一群小鱼。
lines.en: This dark water can raise a whole school of fry.

lines.zh: 我们把身子贴紧，水几乎不流了。
lines.en: We press close, and the water almost stops moving.

lines.zh: 金色的小鱼会从这些卵里出来。
lines.en: Little golden fish will come out of these eggs.

lines.zh: 我们谁都不守卵，游开就算了。
lines.en: Neither of us guards the eggs; we simply swim off.

lines.zh: 我叼起一块沉底的碎肉，吞了。
lines.en: I snatch a scrap of meat from the bottom and swallow it.

lines.zh: 沙里那粒东西发亮，我咬了一下。
lines.en: Something glints in the sand, and I bite it once.

lines.zh: 我捡走你掉的面包屑，比我还大。
lines.en: I take the breadcrumb you dropped; it is bigger than me.

lines.zh: 我用嘴推了推那块石子，不是吃的。
lines.en: I nudge a pebble with my mouth; it is not food.

lines.zh: 沉下来的东西，我第一个到。
lines.en: Whatever sinks, I reach first.

lines.zh: 我衔着一片鱼鳞游了两格，又吐了。
lines.en: I carry a scale two blocks, then spit it out.

lines.zh: 同伴都来抢，我抢到最小那块。
lines.en: The school fights over it, and I get the smallest piece.

lines.zh: 我把东西含在嘴里，鳃还在动。
lines.en: I hold it in my mouth while my gills keep working.

lines.zh: 那枚铁粒太重，我顶不动。
lines.en: That iron nugget is too heavy for me to push.

lines.zh: 我捡东西从不挑，能吞就吞。
lines.en: I never choose; if I can swallow it, I do.

lines.zh: 水里有一小团白点在动，我盯上了。
lines.en: A small white speck moves in the water, and I fix on it.

lines.zh: 我发现了虾群，尾巴先动了。
lines.en: I spot a shoal of shrimp, and my tail moves first.

lines.zh: 它比我小，我比它快，这就够了。
lines.en: It is smaller and slower; that is enough.

lines.zh: 我锁定那只水蚤，慢慢靠过去。
lines.en: I lock onto a water flea and drift closer.

lines.zh: 一片鳞光闪过，我知道那能吃。
lines.en: A flash of scale passes, and I know it is food.

lines.zh: 我把嘴对准那团碎屑，游过去。
lines.en: I aim my mouth at the drifting scraps and swim over.

lines.zh: 目标很小，但地下食物不多。
lines.en: The target is tiny, but food is scarce down here.

lines.zh: 我盯上了钩上那块，也知道危险。
lines.en: I fix on the thing on the hook, knowing the danger.

lines.zh: 同类先冲了，我跟在后面。
lines.en: My schoolmate darts first, and I follow behind.

lines.zh: 我看准了才动，动起来就不停。
lines.en: I look before I move, then I do not stop.

lines.zh: 我绕着它兜圈，每圈都收紧一点。
lines.en: I loop around it, tightening the ring each lap.

lines.zh: 我盯着那点白，鳍尖都在抖。
lines.en: I stare at the white speck, fin tips trembling.

lines.zh: 它往左，我提前在左边等。
lines.en: It goes left, and I am already waiting on the left.

lines.zh: 我不急，地下有的是时间。
lines.en: I am not in a hurry; underground has time to spare.

lines.zh: 我把身子绷直，随时能弹出去。
lines.en: I straighten my body, ready to dart at any moment.

lines.zh: 影子罩住它之前，我不会动。
lines.en: I will not move until my shadow covers it.

lines.zh: 它躲进石缝，我在缝口守着。
lines.en: It hides in a crevice, and I keep watch at the gap.

lines.zh: 金色会暴露我，所以我换了角度。
lines.en: Gold betrays me, so I change my angle.

lines.zh: 目标还在，我就不换目标。
lines.en: The target is still there, and I do not switch.

lines.zh: 我贴着洞底靠近，尽量不搅水。
lines.en: I creep along the floor, trying not to stir the water.

lines.zh: 我咬了一口，力气小，牙却尖。
lines.en: I bite once; I am weak, but my teeth are sharp.

lines.zh: 我用头撞它，撞完就退开。
lines.en: I ram it with my head, then back away.

lines.zh: 这一咬只撕下一小片，够我吃一天。
lines.en: The bite tears off a sliver, enough for a day.

lines.zh: 我咬你的手指，你甩了两下才甩掉。
lines.en: I bite your finger, and you shake it twice to free it.

lines.zh: 我扑上去，整条鱼都弹了起来。
lines.en: I lunge, and my whole body springs forward.

lines.zh: 我咬住不放，尾巴还在猛摆。
lines.en: I hold on, tail beating hard.

lines.zh: 我撞在你手背上，留下一个红点。
lines.en: I strike your hand and leave a red mark.

lines.zh: 我只有三口气的力气，全用上了。
lines.en: I have three breaths of strength, and I spend them all.

lines.zh: 咬完我就钻进石缝，不回头看。
lines.en: After biting, I slip into the crevice without looking back.

lines.zh: 我的牙细得像针，扎进去才知道疼。
lines.en: My teeth are needle-fine; you feel them only after.

lines.zh: 我在三十层以下的暗水里睁开眼。
lines.en: I open my eyes in dark water below level thirty.

lines.zh: 我们五条一起出现，鳞片同时亮。
lines.en: Five of us appear at once, scales brightening together.

lines.zh: 这片地下水域，本来就有我们的位置。
lines.en: This underground water already had a place for us.

lines.zh: 我从石缝间的静水里游出来。
lines.en: I swim out of the still water between the rocks.

lines.zh: 三条在前，两条在后，队伍就这样成形。
lines.en: Three ahead, two behind, and the school takes shape.

lines.zh: 这里有鱼，说明这水是活的。
lines.en: There are fish here; that means this water is alive.

lines.zh: 我第一次见到的光是洞穴苔藓的绿。
lines.en: The first light I saw was green cave moss.

lines.zh: 水很浅，我的背鳍露出一小截。
lines.en: The water is shallow, and a bit of my dorsal shows.

lines.zh: 从卵石到暗渠，我认得每一条路。
lines.en: From pebbles to channels, I know every route.

lines.zh: 我们的金色，是这片黑水里唯一暖色。
lines.en: Our gold is the only warm color in this black water.

lines.zh: 火一燎，我的鳞卷起来，像已经煎过。
lines.en: Flame licks me, and my scales curl as if already fried.

lines.zh: 被摔在石头上，我弹了一下就不动了。
lines.en: Slammed onto stone, I bounce once and go still.

lines.zh: 明明泡在水里，我却换不上气。
lines.en: I am soaking in water, yet I cannot draw a breath.

lines.zh: 炸开的水压把我掀翻，鳞片全散了。
lines.en: The blast wave flips me over and scatters my scales.

lines.zh: 箭穿过来时，我只看见一道水线。
lines.en: When the arrow comes, I see only a line in the water.

lines.zh: 一股冷意钻进鳃里，我的光灭了。
lines.en: A coldness crawls into my gills, and my light goes out.

lines.zh: 水里的碎屑吃完了，我越来越轻。
lines.en: The scraps are gone, and I grow lighter and lighter.

lines.zh: 雷落进水里，我整条身子都在发麻。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the water, and my whole body goes numb.

lines.zh: 水没了，我一路往下掉，连光也没有。
lines.en: The water is gone, I fall, and even the light is gone.
